headline: Senate confirms judge while House takes aim at fraud and EPA rules!

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate considered federal judicial nominations including Kasdin Miller Mitchell for Texas District Court and Matthew R. Byrne for Ohio District Court, with a cloture motion filed on the Byrne nomination. The Senate also passed S. Res. 849 designating the week of September 11-17, 2026, as Patriot Week, and received 33 new executive nominations including judicial, diplomatic, and cabinet positions.

house.lastSessionSummary: The House passed 21 suspension bills covering environmental regulations, military family leave, wildlife protections, and tribal lands. Representative Green announced intent to offer an impeachment resolution against President Trump. Key measures on fraud enforcement and EPA rule disapprovals are scheduled for floor consideration.
